operators.name: batch_norm_eval_forward
semantics: Performs batch normalization in evaluation mode: output = (x - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c] for each channel c, with optional weight/bias if not None.
Broadcasting follows PyTorch BatchNorm2d semantics: per-channel affine parameters applied to all spatial and batch elements.
Uses running_mean and running_var tensors, not batch statistics, because model is in eval mode.
If weight or bias is None, corresponding affine transformation is omitted (i.e., weight treated as 1, bias as 0).
eps is a scalar added to running_var before sqrt for numerical stability.
Applies BatchNorm2d in eval mode using running statistics.
Output tensor shape [32,3,512,256] float32 on CUDA.
Formula: normalized = (x - running_mean) / sqrt(running_var + eps); if affine: output = normalized * weight + bias.
